Founding year — is it really 1894?

The article says the Order was founded in 1894 in Bristol. I have looked through three different Order pamphlets from the 1920s and one of them clearly says 1893. Should we change it? — Mavis_of_Wales (talk) 14:22, 3 Mar 2003 (UTC)

No. The 1893 pamphlet is a known forgery produced by the Cardiff Schism (1922–1924). The Vault holds the original incorporation document and it is dated 14 June 1894. Please do not change the article. — Vault-Warden Beatrix 09:01, 4 Mar 2003 (UTC)

With respect, Vault-Warden, I have been an Adept for 31 years and I have never been allowed to see the "original incorporation document." How do we know it exists? — Geoffrey_1972 11:45, 4 Mar 2003 (UTC)

It exists. — Vault-Warden Beatrix 11:47, 4 Mar 2003 (UTC)

That is not a citation. — Geoffrey_1972 11:51, 4 Mar 2003 (UTC)

Per Tenet VII, the Vault-Warden does not require citations. — Reginald_Quill_Esq 12:18, 4 Mar 2003 (UTC)

Tenet VII says nothing of the kind. Tenet VII is about scale-polishing schedules. Stop weaponizing the tenets to win arguments. — Geoffrey_1972 12:34, 4 Mar 2003 (UTC)

You are thinking of Tenet VII as currently numbered. Before the 1971 renumbering it was Tenet IX, which DID concern matters of Vault discretion. Please consult The Sacred Doctrine, Revised Edition (1973), p. 442. — Reginald_Quill_Esq 12:51, 4 Mar 2003 (UTC)

I have The Sacred Doctrine, Revised Edition (1973) open in front of me. Page 442 is the index. — Geoffrey_1972 13:02, 4 Mar 2003 (UTC)

You have the second printing. I have the first printing. They are different. — Reginald_Quill_Esq 13:14, 4 Mar 2003 (UTC)

This is exactly what I mean when I say the rank structure has become unfalsifiable. I am taking this to the Annual Convocation. — Geoffrey_1972 13:31, 4 Mar 2003 (UTC)

[Thread continues in /Archive_12. Resolved by Convocation vote 4 Apr 2003: 1894 stands.]

The Embalmer's identity

That can't be right. He was a public figure. He ran an embalming practice in Clifton until 1907. The records are in the Bristol Archives. — SCALEFRIEND_88 09:30, 18 Nov 2007 (UTC)

Do not go to the Bristol Archives. — Adept_Custodian_Pemberton 09:32, 18 Nov 2007 (UTC)

I already went. His name was Cornelius — — SCALEFRIEND_88 14:11, 18 Nov 2007 (UTC) [redacted by Vault-Warden 14:13, 18 Nov 2007]

SCALEFRIEND_88 has been temporarily de-scaled pending review. — Vault-Warden Beatrix 14:15, 18 Nov 2007 (UTC)

GEOFFREY DO NOT START. — Vault-Warden Beatrix 19:46, 18 Nov 2007 (UTC)

There is no literature about 1947 because 1947 did not happen. The Convocation was cancelled due to fog. — Reginald_Quill_Esq 08:30, 2 Jul 2011 (UTC)

Fog does not cancel a Convocation. We have met in worse. Something happened in 1947. — Mavis_of_Wales 09:11, 2 Jul 2011 (UTC)

The minutes for 1947 are missing from the Vault. This is confirmed. — Vault-Warden_Eduardo 11:22, 2 Jul 2011 (UTC)

SVG of sigil keeps rendering wrong on IE

I'm seeing the <feDisplacementMap> on the sigil cause IE 11 to render a black square where the sigil should be. Can someone with frontend skills look at this? — Mavis_of_Wales 16:01, 14 May 2016 (UTC)

IE 11 doesn't fully support SMIL animations and has bugs around displacement maps. Easiest fix: detect IE via conditional comment, swap to a PNG fallback. I can write a script. — CodeFriend_2014 17:30, 14 May 2016 (UTC)

Please do not add more JavaScript to the page. It is already 4 MB. — Reginald_Quill_Esq 18:11, 14 May 2016 (UTC)

It would be 200 bytes. — CodeFriend_2014 18:14, 14 May 2016 (UTC)

I do not trust your "bytes." — Reginald_Quill_Esq 18:18, 14 May 2016 (UTC)

Resolution: Fix never implemented. Article still breaks on IE 11. We have decided this is "character."

Rank creep / unilateral promotions

I count 14 self-promotions to "Pangolin-Equal" in the last decade. We have only ever had three legitimate Pangolin-Equals in 130 years. Something is wrong. — Adept_Custodian_Pemberton 22:48, 6 Sep 2019 (UTC)

I promoted myself because nobody else was going to. The Vault-Warden has not held a promotion ceremony since 2007. — SCALEFRIEND_88 23:14, 6 Sep 2019 (UTC) Self-styled: Pangolin-Equal

You cannot promote yourself. That is not how the rank system works. — Adept_Custodian_Pemberton 23:21, 6 Sep 2019 (UTC)

Show me where in the Doctrine it says I cannot. — SCALEFRIEND_88 23:25, 6 Sep 2019 (UTC)

The Doctrine says it implicitly. — Adept_Custodian_Pemberton 23:28, 6 Sep 2019 (UTC)

"Implicitly." — SCALEFRIEND_88 23:29, 6 Sep 2019 (UTC)

Capitalization of "scalebearer"

Is it "Scalebearer", "scalebearer", or "Scale-Bearer"? The article uses all three. — CodeFriend_2014 12:08, 4 Apr 2023 (UTC)

Capitalized when referring to a specific rank-holder, lowercase as a general term, hyphenated only in pre-1971 quotations. — Vault-Warden_Eduardo 12:30, 4 Apr 2023 (UTC)

This is bonkers but okay. Documenting in the style guide. — CodeFriend_2014 12:31, 4 Apr 2023 (UTC)
